small_guidance:
- The conv_transpose kernel is the bottleneck (46.7ms vs 12.2ms baseline). The current gather formulation does redundant work because for stride=2, only 1 in 4 (kh,kw) combinations yields valid (ih,iw) per output position — yet the kernel iterates all KH*KW=16 positions and masks. Restructure to iterate only kh in {(oh+PAD_H) % STRIDE_H} and similarly for kw, cutting inner work by 4×.
- Add larger BLOCK_OC/BLOCK_HW configs (e.g. 128×128, 256×64) with num_warps=8, num_stages=3-4 for the GEMM tile; current best configs are too small for OC=128 and HW=129×129. Also try BLOCK_IC=64 to amortize weight loads.
- Pre-transpose the weight to layout [OC, IC, KH, KW] → [KH, KW, OC, IC] (or [KH*KW, IC, OC]) once at init so the inner `tl.dot(tl.trans(w), x)` becomes `tl.dot(w, x)` with contiguous K-dim and no per-iter trans.
large_guidance:
- Switch from gather-style transposed conv to scatter-add via implicit GEMM in input space: for each (n, ic-tile, h_in-tile, w_in-tile), compute `input[n,ic,h,w] * weight[ic, :, :, :]` outer product and scatter-add into `out[n, :, h*S+kh-P, w*S+kw-P]`. This matches the natural data flow of ConvTranspose2d and reuses each input value KH*KW times from registers. Use atomic-free scatter by partitioning the output among programs by (kh%S, kw%S) phase so each output element is written by exactly one program.
- Alternatively, reformulate as a *direct GEMM* over the dilated/zero-inserted input: precompute mapping so output[n, oc, oh, ow] = Σ_{ic,kh,kw} x_dil[n, ic, oh+kh, ow+kw] * w[ic,oc,kh,kw], then run as a standard im2col-style GEMM with one program per (N, OC-tile, output-spatial-tile) and K = IC*KH*KW. This is the cleanest path on Ampere and lets you use BLOCK_M=128, BLOCK_N=128, BLOCK_K=32 tensor-core tiles.
- Fuse the post-conv softmax+bias+scale+sigmoid into the conv epilogue is hard (needs cross-channel reduction), but you can fuse the bias add of the conv itself into the GEMM epilogue and keep the softmax kernel separate — which is already the structure. Focus the redesign on the conv GEMM tiles, not on further fusion.
